description:
The ideal candidate will be exceptionally organized, detail-oriented, responsive, possess the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks under tight deadlines, and superior written and oral communication skills.

This person will work closely with the Chief of Staff in the DC office to organize and plan the Member's schedule in DC and district, interact with constituents, track events, and respond to all invitations. Strong preference for applicants with scheduling experience. Midwest ties preferred.

Pay and title will be commensurate with experience.
responsibilities: Work closely with the Chief of Staff in the DC office
Organize and plan the Member's schedule in DC and district
qualifications: Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks under tight deadlines
Superior written and oral communication skills
how_to_apply: Any resume, cover letter (not required), and references can be sent to Ashley.Gutwein@mail.house.gov with the subject line: "[Your Full Name] Scheduler/Director of Operations Application."
salary_info: Pay and title will be commensurate with experience.
